summary.zh: 生成交接文档，让新会话接着上次继续
summary.en: Write a handoff doc so a new session can resume the work

description.zh: 把当前目标、进展、已定决策和下一步写成一份交接文档，引用已有文件而不是复制内容，并在保存前隐去密钥等敏感信息。适合结束会话、换机器、上下文快用完或要交给另一个助手接手时使用；首次运行会让你选择保存位置。
description.en: Writes a handoff document with the goal, current state, decisions and next steps, links to existing files instead of copying them and redacts secrets before saving. Good when ending a session or low on context.
